subject: Re: Project Kestrel — ablation status
body:
Hi both,

Kestrel ablation status, halfway through the matrix:

- Core claim reproducing so far: models trained on the MBR-decoded de-en set beat the size-matched web-crawl baseline by +2.1 BLEURT on our news holdout. QE-reranked lands at +1.4, greedy-decoded at +0.3 — the ordering from the release holds in our stack.
- Kaia's granularity result is the surprise: blob-level (multi-sentence) data gives a further +0.8 BLEURT on the document-translation eval even though the sentence-level sets are cleaner to mix. That materially strengthens the case for our doc-translation customers.
- chrF agrees directionally everywhere, so no metric-gaming concerns yet.

Risk: the en-de direction is running ~2 weeks behind because the web-crawl baseline corpus needed dedup against the NewsPaLM sources (Maren caught overlap that would have flattered the baseline). Worth the delay for a defensible memo, but it eats our April buffer.

Linnea
